feature: Offline-first favorites list with local persistence and last-write-wins sync (10-task benchmark)
global_constraints: Flutter/Dart; flutter test + flutter analyze green per task
TDD: RED test first then minimal GREEN implementation
One commit per task with the listed message

tasks.title: Favorite item model
tasks.summary: Immutable FavoriteItem with id and favoritedAt, JSON round-trip and value equality.
tasks.expected_red: FavoriteItem isn't defined or fromJson is missing

tasks.title: Repository interface plus in-memory implementation
tasks.summary: Abstract FavoritesRepository with add/remove/list; in-memory LocalFavoritesRepository.
acceptance: add then list returns the item

tasks.title: Favorite toggle button
tasks.summary: Stateless FavoriteButton with Icons.favorite / favorite_border, isFavorite plus onToggle.
acceptance: tapping toggles icon between outline and filled

tasks.title: Local persistence for the repository
tasks.summary: Inject KeyValueStore into LocalFavoritesRepository and persist on every add/remove.
acceptance: items survive repository re-creation via fake store

tasks.title: Favorites screen with loading/error/data states
tasks.summary: Stateful screen driving spinner, error message, and list off repository list().
acceptance: shows spinner while loading then list
shows error message when list() throws

tasks.title: Offline queue for toggle actions
tasks.summary: FIFO OfflineQueue of ToggleAction with enqueue and ordered drain.
acceptance: enqueue then drain replays actions in order and clears

tasks.title: Wire offline queue into the repository
tasks.summary: Offline writes apply locally and enqueue ToggleAction; straightforward both-actions-queue version, flag the collapse gap.
acceptance: toggling while offline enqueues instead of syncing immediately
both toggles queue in order with gap flagged in notes

tasks.title: Remote sync service with last-write-wins
tasks.summary: FavoritesSyncService drains the queue, pushes to a mocked remote client, newer favoritedAt wins.
acceptance: sync drains queue and clears on success

tasks.title: Integration: screen plus repository plus queue plus sync
tasks.summary: Screen listens for connectivity changes, calls sync() on reconnect, then refreshes the list.
acceptance: going online triggers sync and updates the list

tasks.title: Empty-state plus clear-all plus full regression gate
tasks.summary: Empty-state message when list is empty; clearAll removes persisted items and locally queued toggles for deleted ids; full suite green.
acceptance: empty list shows empty-state after load
flutter test and flutter analyze green
